# Blue Raeven Farms

> Family-owned Oregon farm and pie company. Handcrafted fruit pies, small-batch jams, and artisan syrups made with berries grown on our own 130+ acres in the Willamette Valley since 1928.

## Visit Us

- [Farmstand & Pie Shop Locations](https://blueraevenfarms.com/farmstand/): Hours, addresses, and phone numbers for both Blue Raeven Farmstand in Amity, OR (20650 S Hwy 99W) and Blue Raeven Pie Company in McMinnville, OR (1101 NE Alpine Ave). Also lists the area grocery stores and local farmstands carrying our pies.
- [Contact Us](https://blueraevenfarms.com/contact/): Contact form for orders, events, wholesale or fundraising inquiries. Includes direct phone, email, and physical address.

## Our Pies & More

- [Handcrafted Pies](https://blueraevenfarms.com/pies-more/pies/): Full catalog of available pies — Apple, Apple Crumb, Blue Raeven Berry (blueberry/boysenberry/marionberry blend), Boysenberry, Marionberry, and more. Pre-order and pickup info.
- [Jams & Spreads](https://blueraevenfarms.com/pies-more/jams-spreads/): Small-batch fruit jams and spreads made with the same berries that fill our pies. Available at our farmstand and select grocery partners.
- [Other Confections](https://blueraevenfarms.com/pies-more/other-confections/): Gourmet fruit syrups — Blueberry, Boysenberry, Marionberry, Raspberry, Peach, and Tayberry — sold at the Amity Farmstand.
- [Baking Instructions & FAQs](https://blueraevenfarms.com/pies-more/baking-instructions-faqs/): How to bake a frozen Blue Raeven pie (350°F conventional / 325°F convection, 75-90 minutes for 9-inch pies). Also covers fresh-baked re-warming and common questions.

## Our Story

- [Our Story](https://blueraevenfarms.com/story/): The Lewis family's four-generation farming history in Oregon's Willamette Valley. Timeline from the Deraeves family's 1928 founding through the launch of Blue Raeven Pie Company in 2007 and the modern pie kitchen.
- [Our Berries](https://blueraevenfarms.com/story/our-berries/): The fruit that makes the pies — marionberries, boysenberries, blueberries, blackberries, tayberries, strawberries, apples, and peaches grown on 130+ acres at Blue Raeven Farms.

## Wholesale & Fundraising

- [Wholesale & Fundraising](https://blueraevenfarms.com/wholesale-fundraising/): Resources for retailers carrying Blue Raeven pies, and information about fundraising programs for schools, sports teams, and community groups. Includes downloadable order forms and tally sheets.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 1928 by the Deraeves family in Amity, Oregon; pie company launched in 2007 by Ronald and Jamie Lewis (third-generation farmers).
- Two physical locations:
  - **Blue Raeven Farmstand** — 20650 S Hwy 99W, Amity, OR 97101 — (503) 835-0740 — Mon-Sat 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Sun 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
  - **Blue Raeven Pie Company** (pie shop) — 1101 NE Alpine Ave, McMinnville, OR 97128 — (503) 474-2856 — Tue-Sat 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Sun-Mon closed
- 130+ acres of berry and tree-fruit production in the Willamette Valley.
- Notable pie varieties: Apple, Apple Crumb, Blue Raeven Berry (signature blueberry/boysenberry/marionberry blend), Boysenberry, Marionberry, Cherry, Strawberry-Rhubarb, and seasonal varieties.
- Products: 9-inch and 5-inch frozen ready-to-bake pies, small-batch jams and fruit spreads, gourmet fruit syrups (blueberry, boysenberry, marionberry, raspberry, peach, tayberry).
- Distribution: direct from farmstand + pie shop, regional Pacific Northwest grocery partners (including New Seasons Market, Market of Choice, Roth's IGA, Newport Avenue Market, Zupan's, Harvest Fresh Grocery, Oliver Lemon's, Otto's Sausage Kitchen, and 14+ area farmstands), plus wholesale and fundraising channels.
- Tagline: "Because Pie Fixes Everything ®"
